captions.detailed: A matte-black camera speedlight flash featuring a blocky, rectangular lamp head mounted on a dual-axis articulation neck. The main body is a stepped vertical pillar with a small hot-shoe mount at the base and a rectangular battery door panel on the side. The head can tilt horizontally via its mounting bracket, while the entire upper neck swivels vertically relative to the lower body.
captions.instruction: Create an articulated camera speedlight flash with a stepped main body, a shoe mount, a side battery door, and a rectangular flash head. The head should be mounted via a dual-axis assembly that allows horizontal swiveling and vertical tilting.
captions.factory: Construct the main body using a stepped stack of boxes and cylinders, adding a thin vertical plate for the battery door and a small flat shoe mount at the base. Create a swivel neck from a cylinder and a horizontal bracket. Model the rectangular flash head as a box, and define joints for the vertical swivel, horizontal tilt, and battery door hinge.
